title: Syllabus Overview
notes: Unit 7: Evolutionary Biology · B: Zoology · 15 teaching hours

• Life and its Origin: Oparin-Haldane theory, Miller and Urey's experiment.
  • Evidences of evolution: Morphological, Anatomical, Paleontological, Embryological, Biochemical.
  • Theories of evolution: Lamarckism, Darwinism, Neo-Darwinism.
  • Human evolution: Position of man in animal kingdom, comparisons (New/Old World monkeys, apes, humans), human ancestral evolutionary line.
